resources.string: To show the red low-battery bar over other apps, please grant the “Display over other apps” permission.
Monitoring is active.\nA red bar will appear at the top of the screen when the battery drops below %1$d%% and disappear when charging or back above the limit.
The red warning bar appears automatically below 10%% battery and goes away on its own once you plug in the charger or the level rises back above 10%%.
Keeps the low-battery bar service running in the background
